def factor_intraday_volume_coherence_ewm(df):
    """Intraday return weighted by relative volume, smoothed with exponential moving average to capture persistent price-volume coherence with greater reactiveness."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    vol_ma = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    vol_ratio = df_copy["volume"] / vol_ma.replace(0, np.nan)
    confirmation = intraday_ret * vol_ratio
    smooth_conf = confirmation.ewm(span=10, min_periods=10).mean()
    factor = smooth_conf.ffill().fillna(0)
    df_copy["factor_intraday_volume_coherence_ewm"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_intraday_volume_coherence_ewm"]
description: This factor captures the alignment between intraday price movement and volume intensity using exponential smoothing for greater reactiveness. Intraday return (from alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday) is multiplied by the ratio of current volume to its 20-day average. Large positive (negative) values indicate strong upward (downward) intraday moves accompanied by high relative volume, signaling conviction. The 10-day exponential moving average provides a more recent-biased smoothing than a simple rolling mean, potentially improving responsiveness while preserving the core price-volume coherence mechanism.
